entries.zh: 沟；水沟、沟渠（引水或排水之沟道）
entries.en: ditch; water channel, drain

entries.zh: 管；水管、筒管（导水之管筒）
entries.en: pipe; tube, conduit (for water)

entries.zh: 鸭嘴管；唢呐类管乐器（chirimía）的吹管、吹嘴
entries.en: duck-bill pipe; mouthpiece/pipe of a chirimía (shawm)

entries.zh: 沟洼；沟渠低洼积水处（第二字存疑）
entries.en: ditch hollow; sunken water channel (second character uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字栏带〔疑：窪/窑〕标记，且闽南/官话音写第二音节 cūi 亦可通'水'，按'沟洼'释义并降为 medium。

entries.zh: 沟壑；大水沟、沟谷
entries.en: ditch and ravine; gully, watercourse

entries.zh: 酒筩；蒸酒（蒸馏）取酒用的竹管、酒筒
entries.en: wine-tube; pipe for distilling wine (still-pipe)

entries.zh: 圳沟；田间引水灌溉的沟渠、田沟
entries.en: irrigation ditch; field water channel (furrow trench)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔Definition uncertain: original columns missing〕
entries.notes: 西语词头 'Cañon. q. pluma.'（或为笔管、大羽管义），但汉字、闽南、官话三栏皆〔空〕，材料不足，按要求标注残缺存疑。

entries.zh: 劳；劳累、辛劳（操劳至疲乏）
entries.en: to toil, labor; to grow weary, tire

entries.zh: 劳烦；劳苦烦扰（使人烦劳）
entries.en: to toil and trouble; weary, annoy

entries.zh: 惰；懒惰（倦怠懒散）
entries.en: lazy, slothful; weary, indolent

entries.zh: 倦；因（枉屈）劳苦而疲倦
entries.en: weary, worn out (with unjust toil); fatigued

entries.zh: 厌；厌倦、厌烦（对某事生厌）
entries.en: tired of, weary of something; annoyed

entries.zh: 劳；劳碌、疲劳
entries.en: to toil; weary, fatigue

entries.zh: 饿；饥饿（又含气馁义；字迹存疑）
entries.en: hungry, famished; faint for want of food
entries.notes: 汉字栏带〔疑：餒/餓〕标记；闽南音写 būe 更近'餓'，按饥饿义释义并降为 medium。

entries.zh: 困；困乏、疲惫不堪（力竭）
entries.en: exhausted, worn out; overcome with fatigue
entries.notes: 闽南/官话音写栏带 T99（污损难辨）标记，按纪律降为 low；释义据清晰的'困'与西语 cansado, rendido 给出。

entries.zh: 厌倦、疲乏（原稿字存疑：屑/厭）
entries.en: weariness, fatigue; disgust (character uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字栏带〔疑：屑/厭〕标记，闽南音写 hiânşiag 亦更近'厭'类音，释义存疑降为 medium。

entries.zh: 着劳；受劳成倦（劳而烦倦）
entries.en: to be wearied and annoyed; to labor and vex

entries.zh: 脚酸；脚腿酸软疲疼
entries.en: sore, aching feet; weariness in the legs

entries.zh: 劳心；操心、忧思费神（心神劳倦）
entries.en: mental weariness; to worry, trouble the mind

entries.zh: 劳力；体力劳苦、气力疲乏
entries.en: weariness of strength; bodily toil

entries.zh: 劳倦；因劳作而困倦
entries.en: weary from work; fatigued by labor
